Short library

Learn palmistry

Observation vs. interpretation

Observation: “A candidate path is observed.”
Classification: “The system groups it as a possible heart line.”
Interpretation: “In some schools it is associated with expressiveness.”

Main lines

The heart, head, and life lines are traditionally studied along with their shape, continuity, ending, and relationship to other lines. The life line does not predict lifespan.

Mounts, fingers, and symbols

Schools differ in their methods. A mark is never interpreted in isolation: its location, nearby lines, and context are considered. A 2D photo can’t establish body volume accurately.

Privacy

Photos are personal information. The palmistry tool processes them in your browser and only saves them if you tap “Save.” They are not used to train models without consent.
